parsed.explanation: Made the fragment well-formed XML and restored obvious 18th-century book-ad structure: escaped & as &; closed the unclosed Sapientia BIBL; repaired mojibake (Augustinergasse, Völker, Bödickers, Grundsätze, 8°); moved the Prideaux Connexion-phrase into TITLE; treated leading 4. as FORMAT (quarto) and 1I as II; retagged Cattenburg as its own BIBL/AUTHOR instead of PRIZE; and placed punctata with the Hebrew-Bible TITLE, leaving Leusdenii as AUTHOR.
